text.text_excerpt: Stumbled across this food truck parked on Carondelet between Howard & Calliope (river side of the WDSU building) building during lunchtime. I really didn't need a burger, but I like to support small/new businesses and I hadn't heard of this truck so I decided to check it out. Burger toppings are unique and I ended up with one called the "Gringo" - topped with avocado, pico de gallo, and a lime-zest mayo plus there was seasoning on the burger. Seemed like great quality ingredients and tasted great - no complaints. I also got a side of mac & cheese which was a casserole with spaghetti noodles of all things but it was homemade, cheesy and quite good. The burger was $8 and the mac & cheese wa...

A friend recommended their veggie burger...which I had never seen on their menu so I asked the next time they were parked by work, as again it wasn't on the menu. And yes they had some! Their veggie burger is beet based so it was a pretty purple and it was nicely spicy with a nutty crunch so definitely a tasty version. The burgers come with lettuce (nicely crisp), slice of tomato (really ripe) and homemade pickles (delish) then you can finish dressing with mayo, yellow mustard and ketchup at the counter. The bun was soft and not seeded (my preference). I wish I knew consistently if they had the veg burger before I sought them out. Also since I ordered off their regular menu I had no idea ...

I'm not a big burger person but thought I'd try these guys as the food truck has started coming to our office complex once a week. I had "The Melt" for $9 which comes with cheese, root beer braised onions, mushrooms and bacon. The burger is nicely cooked and well seasoned but not salty. The toppings were great and on a soft, fresh brioche bun. So good! One of the best burgers I've had and from a food truck! Also, not a tiny bit greasy and all fresh. I highly recommend!!
